title: It Starts with Us
author: Colleen Hoover
summary: Picking up after It Ends with Us, Lily is starting over with a flower shop and a young daughter, while Atlas, her first love, returns and her ex-husband remains in her life.
readIf: you read the first book and want to see where Lily and Atlas end up.
skipIf: you have not read It Ends with Us, or want to avoid domestic abuse themes.
